AssessmentTable.title: AssessmentTable

BlindingChoice.title: BlindingChoice

CampaignInputs.title: CampaignInputs

CampaignPackage.title: CampaignPackage

ClientUpload.description: The files just stored (a filled template is read at once), and the page.
ClientUpload.title: ClientUpload

CoCompoundSpec.description:
Another compound of a model system in the simulation: dosed with its own protocol (an enantiomer, a co-dosed
parent) or, with no protocol, only formed (a metabolite).
CoCompoundSpec.title: CoCompoundSpec

CompetitiveInhibition.description: Reversible competitive inhibition of an enzyme/transporter (PK-Sim ``CompetitiveInhibition``).
CompetitiveInhibition.title: CompetitiveInhibition

default: Cellular partition coefficient method - Rodgers and Rowland
calculation_methods.title: Calculation Methods

CoverageRow.description: One data-plan item and the evidence that covers it (`evidence_register.Coverage`).
CoverageRow.title: CoverageRow

CpfVersion.description: The assembled CPF's version, and the assembly report (what came from which evidence).
CpfVersion.title: CpfVersion

CpfView.description: `cpf_view.project_cpf_view`: the compound screen's parameter rows and the S0 completeness.
CpfView.title: CpfView

DataPlanStatus.description: The data plan version a phase page is computed from, and its status.
DataPlanStatus.title: DataPlanStatus

Demographics.description:
The representative individual a study is simulated with (MS-01 §2.3).

Age, sex and population (ethnicity) define a typical PK-Sim individual; PK-Sim derives weight, height
and organ sizes from the population physiology for that age and sex. A study mean ``weight_kg`` /
``height_cm`` is written into the individual's ``OriginData`` (``Weight`` in kg, ``Height`` in cm, keys harvested
from the OSP Midazolam model's Korean individual) and PK-Sim scales the physiology to it.
Demographics.title: Demographics

Deviation.description:
A change to the plan after its MAP was signed (D-14, ICH M15 §4.2): it applies to campaigns only once the MIDD
lead signs it, which makes a new MAP version superseding the signed one.
Deviation.title: Deviation

DiffRow.description: A departure from the MS-01 default (`modeler_project.plan.diff`); `proposal` only on a pending A5 proposal.
DiffRow.title: DiffRow

Disposition.description: D1: binding and distribution, then each elimination / transport pathway.
Disposition.title: Disposition

DosePhase.description:
One phase of a regimen whose doses differ: ``n_doses`` doses of ``dose_mg`` (mg, or mg/kg for a per-kg study),
``interval_h`` apart, the first ``start_h`` after the regimen starts. A loading dose then maintenance is two
phases (OSP Voriconazole, Saari 2006: 400 mg twice 12 h apart, then 200 mg every 12 h from 24 h).
DosePhase.title: DosePhase

DosePhaseSpec.description: One phase of a regimen: ``repetitions`` doses of ``dose``, ``interval_h`` apart, the first at ``start_h``.
DosePhaseSpec.title: DosePhaseSpec

EngineBinding.description:
Where a parameter lives in a PK-Sim snapshot (MS-01 §2.1).

`building_block` is Compound/Individual/Formulation/Protocol. For a compound process the `process`
field carries the process internal name and, for molecule-based processes, the molecule after a
colon, e.g. "MetabolizationSpecific_FirstOrder:CYP3A4"; `parameter` is the engine parameter name.
Individual, Simulation and ExpressionProfile bindings carry the full PK-Sim path in `parameter`. A Simulation
binding's `route` limits it to the simulations dosed that way (the published model sets it only there).
EngineBinding.title: EngineBinding

EngineIdentity.description: What produced the numbers: real PK-Sim, a software fixture, or an injected engine (never read as PBPK).
EngineIdentity.title: EngineIdentity

EscalationResolved.description: A signed decision applied to a single-node campaign: the stage's new status (and the stages still to run).
EscalationResolved.title: EscalationResolved

EvidenceChoice.description: A value kept for its parameter: the ids of the other values it rejected, and the page.
EvidenceChoice.title: EvidenceChoice

EvidenceCorrection.description: A corrected copy of a value, and the page.
EvidenceCorrection.title: EvidenceCorrection

ExpressionSpec.description:
An enzyme, transporter or other-protein expression profile. Real OSP transporter profiles carry no
Localization (PK-Sim supplies it for the named transporter), so it is emitted only when set; enzymes keep
the standard intracellular localization by default.

``harvested`` is a profile copied verbatim from an OSP reference snapshot (`pbpk_domain.expression`): its
per-organ relative expressions, half-lives, transport directions and ontogeny. Without those every organ's
relative expression is zero and the protein's processes do nothing, so a campaign build always uses a
harvested profile; the bare form (molecule and reference concentration only) exists for builder tests.
ExpressionSpec.title: ExpressionSpec

FeedbackEvidence.description: New evidence after an S5 failure (plan §12.3 N4 c): one parameter's measured value, in the CPF's own unit.
FeedbackEvidence.title: FeedbackEvidence

HarvestedProcess.description:
A process of a type in HARVESTED_PROCESSES, written with exactly the parameters the CPF carries for it (PK-Sim
computes the ones a snapshot leaves out, e.g. kcat from an in-vitro Vmax).
HarvestedProcess.title: HarvestedProcess

HistoryRow.description: One version of an artifact, and the field changes from the previous one (blinded values left out).
HistoryRow.title: HistoryRow

IdentityProposal.description: The structure proposed as evidence (its id), and the page.
IdentityProposal.title: IdentityProposal

ImpactView.description: `deps.impact_view`: what a change would replace and which downstream artifacts it makes stale.
ImpactView.title: ImpactView

IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec.description:
An IV bolus: PK-Sim ``IntravenousBolus`` with a start time and InputDose, no infusion time (harvested from the
OSP Alfentanil, Midazolam, Digoxin, Metformin and Verapamil protocols, simple and schema form).
IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec.title: IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec

default: maximum rounds reached without passing the gate
a fitted parameter sits at its bound
two fitted parameters correlate > 0.95 after fixing one
CV > 50% on a parameter the question of interest depends on
no permitted diagnostic action left to try
escalation_triggers.title: Escalation Triggers

MapReading.description:
A confirmed reading: the preview's fields, the datasets it proposed and the page, merged into one object
(today's shape; the owner chose to keep it, 2026-10-08). Where both name a key the page's wins: `dissolution` is
the page's profiles and comparisons, not the preview's record count.
MapReading.title: MapReading

MapScenario.description:
One internal study's simulation plan — what `build_round_snapshot` turns into a simulation.

Carries the studied individual's demographics (population, sex, age) so the round build can construct the
PK-Sim individual; ``infusion_time_min`` is the IV infusion duration (required for an IV scenario).
MapScenario.title: MapScenario

MapVersion.description: The latest MAP version, its hash and the campaign inputs its signature staged.
MapVersion.title: MapVersion

MappingBody.description:
How to read a sheet: the page's form (`form`) or a mapping recipe (`proposal`, the data-mapping agent's shape or
written by a person); the study facts the sheet does not state; and whether to keep the result (False: preview).
MappingBody.title: MappingBody

Measured.description: A value with its unit and provenance, as it will appear in the snapshot.
Measured.title: Measured

MichaelisMentenMetabolism.description:
Saturable enzyme metabolism (PK-Sim ``MetabolizationSpecific_MM``). Parameter names and units are
from the OSP Rifampicin model; Vmax and Km are the identifiable pair (MS-01 §2.2), kcat and enzyme
concentration are optional and only emitted when supplied.
MichaelisMentenMetabolism.title: MichaelisMentenMetabolism

MicrosomalMichaelisMenten.description:
Saturable metabolism scaled from liver microsomes (PK-Sim ``MetabolizationLiverMicrosomes_MM``). Names and
units are from the OSP Midazolam model (CYP3A4, UGT1A4): the in-vitro Vmax per mg microsomal protein and, where
the model sets it, the enzyme content of the microsomes; Km; and kcat, which the published model fits and which
then governs the in-vivo rate.
MicrosomalMichaelisMenten.title: MicrosomalMichaelisMenten

OverallStudy.description: A study of Overall Data: what the plan knows about it, and where it is placed now.
OverallStudy.title: OverallStudy

ParamNode.description: A CPF parameter on D1 / D2, with its fit choice and the stages that may fit it; D2 nodes carry no source.
ParamNode.title: ParamNode

ParticleFormulationSpec.description:
Particle dissolution (PK-Sim ``Formulation_Particles``, Noyes-Whitney) with a monodisperse size distribution,
as the OSP Ketoconazole model writes it: the unstirred water layer thickness, the distribution type (0:
monodisperse, the only one placed here) and the mean particle radius. Dissolution is limited by the compound's
solubility, so a "solution" given as 8 nm particles (the model's PD_solution) still respects it.
ParticleFormulationSpec.title: ParticleFormulationSpec

PlacementPreview.description: A move's dry run: what the validator and the diff would say; nothing is saved.
PlacementPreview.title: PlacementPreview

PlanSigned.description: The page after `plan:sign`, and the signature the MAP carries.
PlanSigned.title: PlanSigned

objective.default: Predict exposure for the question of interest
objective.title: Objective

Proposal.description: An A5 departure from the plan, shown in the diff until a person accepts or rejects it.
Proposal.title: Proposal

PublishedIndividual.description:
The individual a published model simulates one study in, when it differs from the model's main individual
(the OSP Rifampicin model's "EHC off" individual for its 7-day study; the Midazolam model's Korean individual,
CYP3A5 *3/*3, for Yu 2004). ``parameters`` is that individual's complete set of physiology overrides (it replaces
the CPF's indiv.* records for this study: a value the main individual sets and this one does not is left at the
PK-Sim default, never invented); ``expression`` holds its profile values that differ from the harvested library.
Paths and units are copied from the snapshot.
PublishedIndividual.title: PublishedIndividual

QuestionOfInterest.description: The parts of the question the split depends on (MS-01 §3.3 rules 4 and 5).
QuestionOfInterest.title: QuestionOfInterest

QuestionRecord.description: A question of interest the project answers.
QuestionRecord.title: QuestionRecord

RealDataSummary.description: What a round's verdict rests on (`pbpk_domain.data_origin.real_data_summary`, plan §9.4).
RealDataSummary.title: RealDataSummary

ReconciledRow.description: One client item of the data plan and what arrived for it (`client_data.Reconciled`).
ReconciledRow.title: ReconciledRow

ReleaseProposal.description: A profile's fit proposed as release-model evidence: the evidence ids, and the page.
ReleaseProposal.title: ReleaseProposal

RunSummary.description:
One agent run as a page lists it: the run record's own keys (`run_store.start_run` writes all of them; the run
is unfinished while `finished_at` is null). Not every page lists the provider.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

Sample.description: What the recipe read, in a person's terms (values withheld for an external study before the MAP is signed).
Sample.title: Sample

SheetForm.description: What a person tells the page about one sheet. Columns are letters; rows are the sheet's own row numbers.

header_row.description: The row with the column headers (times across: the times)
header_row.title: Header Row

SheetForm.title: SheetForm

SheetView.description: One sheet as text, the reading form's first filling and what was found.
SheetView.title: SheetView

SignatureCreated.description: A Part 11 signature, from the token's step-up (never a password).
SignatureCreated.title: SignatureCreated

SnapshotPreview.description: A built and validated PK-Sim snapshot, not persisted; the snapshot is PK-Sim's own JSON.
SnapshotPreview.title: SnapshotPreview

SpecificBinding.description: Specific binding to a target (PK-Sim ``SpecificBinding``); names/units from the OSP Midazolam model.
SpecificBinding.title: SpecificBinding

objective.default: Predict exposure for the question of interest
objective.title: Objective

StudyRecord.description: A clinical study as it arrives from intake (MS-01 §3.1), reduced to the fields the split needs.
StudyRecord.title: StudyRecord

StudyRow.description: An observed study as stored for the project. D-15: a blinded external study comes without its profile.
StudyRow.title: StudyRow

StudyView.description: What the plan knows about a study (from the P4 catalog): enough to plan and validate, no observed values.
StudyView.title: StudyView

SystemView.description: The project's model system as stored (`pbpk_domain.system`): compounds, roles, products, analytes.
SystemView.title: SystemView

TemplateContent.description:
A starting point in full. The CPF and the studies are the template's own documents, in the upload shapes they
are sent back in (a reference model's CPF, the blank one's empty parameters; studies with their origin).
TemplateContent.title: TemplateContent

TransporterMichaelisMenten.description:
Saturable active transport (PK-Sim ``ActiveTransportSpecific_MM``). Names/units from the OSP
Rifampicin model. The transporter needs an expression profile (``ExpressionSpec`` type Transporter).
TransporterMichaelisMenten.title: TransporterMichaelisMenten

Uncertainty.description: A fitted parameter's precision, from the parameter identification's confidence-interval estimate.
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

VersionView.description: `deps.version_view`: an artifact version's identity, status, provenance and approvals (content when asked).
VersionView.title: VersionView

get.description: List the tenant's campaigns (summary + stage/round detail); ``?project=`` narrows to one project.

One campaign's monitor view. 404 when it is not in the tenant; 403 when the caller is not a member of
the campaign's project (checked after the lookup, since the project is a property of the campaign, not the URL).

post.description: Record a signed deviation from the MAP and inform the running stage workflow.

The signed decision on a failed external validation (plan §12.4 FEEDBACK_PENDING): limitation (accept_best),
learn, new evidence, or stop (abort).

The S7 package: reproduction verdict, whether it may be exported (D13), hashes, and the downloadable
artifacts. Server paths are never returned.

Download the package zip or the rendered MAR. The zip is refused while reproduction has not passed (D13);
only files inside the object store are ever served.

post.description: Resume an escalated stage with a signed decision. The signature is verified before any signal is sent.
Resume, accept or abort an escalated stage of a single-node campaign, with a Part 11 signature.

get.description: The client-data workbook (D-11): README plus one sheet per kind of data, read with no AI.
Open campaign escalations awaiting a signed decision (review inbox).

post.description: Build and validate a snapshot without persisting it.
A person supplies the paper the agent asked for; it is stored as a citable document.

get.description: This project's audit events (newest first) and whether the tenant's chain verifies.

put.description: The MIDD lead's choice for this project (D-15), with its reason, on the audit chain.
Change fields (each change says why). With ``preview`` the impact is returned and nothing is saved.

post.description: L1 gate (D-07: a named approval, meaning "Reviewed"): refused while anything blocks the brief.
Start a modeling campaign through the configured execution backend (local single-node, or Temporal).
Store each file; read a filled template at once; triage any other workbook.

get.description:
One sheet as text, with a first filling of the reading form found in it (units, dose and LLOQ quoted from their
cells; what the sheet does not say left for the person) and the notes that say what was found and what was not.

post.description: A person says what a sheet holds (overrides code and A4).

Apply a mapping recipe deterministically. Preview shows the records, problems and open questions; confirming a
recipe with none of them creates the datasets (origin CLIENT) and keeps the recipe on the file's record.
Close P3: snapshot the files and the reconciliation, with a named approval.

The manual path for observed data (typed from a table or a report). Its origin says what it is: synthetic or
illustrative data are accepted for software checks but can never pass a gate (plan §9.4).
A blinded dataset's values for one check (digitization, acceptance), with the reason on the audit chain.
A figure digitized by a person: the server maps the picked pixels with the calibration (no client arithmetic).

Propose a profile's fit as a formulation's release model: evidence to accept or reject on the Parameters tab
(which profile represents in vivo release is a planning decision, D-12).
The manual path: a person enters a value with its source. A quote from a stored document is checked verbatim.
Keep this value for its parameter: the other accepted values of the same target are rejected with the reason.

Correct the parameter a value is for, or its conditions: a corrected copy replaces it (the original is kept,
rejected, pointing at the copy).
Run A2 (values) or, with ``?agent=A3``, the observed-data agent, in the background.
What saving `content` as the next version of `kind/id` would change and make stale. Saves nothing.

put.description: A structure choice with its reason; the inputs are re-assembled with it.

post.description: Propose the molecular weight from the brief's PubChem record (accepted like any other evidence).
Hand the accepted CPF v1 and the judged studies to the campaign path (the project's CPF and studies).

put.description: A study dropped on a D3 node: placed by a person (userLocked), with the reason. ``dry_run`` validates only.
A structure choice; the default split depends on some of them, so non-locked placements follow the new default.

post.description: New inputs (P4 changed): the default is recomputed, a person's choices are kept, new studies are marked.
Approve and sign: the MAP generated from the plan, signed (Part 11, step-up), and the campaign inputs staged.

get.description: Read-only view for viewers (the plan must exist).

post.description: Stage the CPF, generate + persist the MAP, and derive observed PK, returning the runner's inputs.
Generate the MAP (version 1, DRAFT) for a question from its CPF, studies and context.

put.description: A person's decision on one item (who provides it, for what, cross-check it) — kept across re-derivations.

post.description: Closes P1 with the brief (D-07: named approval). The brief must be approved first and the plan up to date.

get.description: The observed clinical studies uploaded for this project (what the campaign fits and validates against).

post.description: Add observed studies to the project, replacing any with the same ``study_id`` and keeping the rest.

put.description:
Relate the project's compounds as one model system (parent, enantiomers, metabolites): roles, formation links,
products with their dose fractions (required: never defaulted), published sum observers and analytes. Each
compound's CPF is put first; the system is checked against them before it is stored.

post.description: P0: create the project from the drug name and the technical proposal, then start the extraction.
